=== summary ===
Release handbook
=== content ===
How we ship, in order. See [architecture/overview](https://yt.example.com/youtrack/article/ACME-A-3) and
[the architecture overview](https://yt.example.com/youtrack/article/ACME-A-3) for the shape of the system,
and [operations/runbook#Rollback](https://yt.example.com/youtrack/article/ACME-A-4#Rollback) for what to do when it goes wrong.

The planning/backlog-grooming page is not published yet, and GIT-US-0042
is a backlog item rather than a page.

![The release train](train.png)

The signed checklist is [in the release pack](release-pack.pdf).

Bare issue ids such as ACME-42 are left alone: YouTrack auto-links them itself.

```md
This fenced sample documents the syntax: [[architecture/overview]] and
![alt](./images/train.png) must both survive untouched.
```

So must an inline `[[architecture/overview]]` code span.
